name: Screeslide Revenant

abilities.name: Swallowing Shale
abilities.description: If the revenant is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, the creature takes 9 (2d8) thunder damage and the revenant can immediately use Entomb on it without spending a bonus action.

abilities.name: Buried in Scree
abilities.description: While the revenant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from loose scree, rubble, or heaped stone.

abilities.name: Entomb
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the revenant entombs one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While entombed, the target is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the revenant, and takes 7 (2d6) thunder damage at the start of each of the revenant's turns. The revenant can have only one creature entombed at a time. If the revenant takes 15 damage or more in a single turn from the entombed creature, the revenant must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the revenant. If the revenant dies, an entombed creature breaks free prone by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The revenant makes two Crushing Slide attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Scouring Scree.

actions.name: Crushing Slide
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Scouring Scree
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

generation.userConcept: a quarry-pit thing of living scree that buries what it catches
